137 = 被 SIGKILL（OOM 的典型特征）: 137 = killed by SIGKILL (typical of an OOM kill)
137 常见于 OOM 或被 SIGKILL；0 = 正常退出: 137 usually means OOM or SIGKILL; 0 = exited normally
CrashLoopBackOff / ImagePullBackOff 等；正常: CrashLoopBackOff / ImagePullBackOff etc.; empty when normal
Deployment 名，也是 app 标签值（选择器锚它，建后不可改）: Deployment name, also used as the app label value (the selector is anchored to it and cannot be changed after creation)
False = 明确不健康；Unknown = 失联（kubelet 不上报了）: False = definitely unhealthy; Unknown = unreachable (kubelet has stopped reporting)
OOMKilled / Error / Completed…；从没重启过则为空: OOMKilled / Error / Completed etc.; empty if it has never restarted
OOMKilled = 内存不够，调 limits；Error = 进程自己挂了: OOMKilled = out of memory, adjust the limits; Error = the process crashed on its own, check the logs
Pod 起不来，没有节点能放下它（Event reason=FailedSche: The pod cannot be scheduled because no node can fit it (Event reason=FailedScheduling)
RFC3339。下一轮把它填进 since，就是一条不重不漏的游标: RFC3339. Pass this into `since` on the next poll to get a cursor with no gaps or duplicates
RFC3339（如 2026-08-28T10:00:00Z）。**轮询场景必填: RFC3339 (e.g. 2026-08-28T10:00:00Z). **Required when polling**: pass in the previous round's checked_at, otherwise every poll re-fetches the same batch of alerts. Compared against the event's "last seen" time, not when it first occurred
Ready 条件非 True 的个数——告警判断直接用它: Number of nodes whose Ready condition is not True — used directly for alerting
Running 也可能挂过——它被拉起来了: Even Running may have crashed before — it was restarted
app 标签平台自动打，别在这里覆盖: The app label is set automatically by the platform; do not override it here
false = 更新了已有的: false = an existing one was updated
kubectl apply 的通用兜底：Service/ConfigMap/Cr: A general-purpose fallback equivalent to kubectl apply: resources not covered by a dedicated operation (Service/ConfigMap/CronJob/Ingress etc.) go through this. Supports multiple `---`-separated documents; uses server-side apply (creates if absent, updates if present)
kubelet 给的原因，如 The node was low on resou: The reason given by kubelet, e.g. "The node was low on resource: memory" — **which resource is short is stated here**
true = 命中的比 limit 多，**还有没返回的**。轮询时看到它就该调: true = there were more matches than the limit, **so some were not returned**. If you see this while polling, increase the limit or shorten the interval — silently truncating like this used to quietly drop alerts whenever the cluster got busy
wait 关掉时恒为 false，表示「未等到结果」而非失败: Always false when wait is off, meaning "the result was not waited for", not a failure
一个 Deployment 起没起来：期望/就绪/可用副本数与镜像。部署后接它判: Whether a Deployment has come up: desired/ready/available replica counts and image. Chain this after a deploy to check readiness
从原文里认出来的；认不出为空: Recognized from the raw message; empty if it could not be recognized
关掉 = 提交就返回，不带回结果与日志: Off = returns as soon as submitted, without the result or logs
列出命名空间里的 deployment（期望/就绪副本数、镜像）: Lists the Deployments in a namespace (desired/ready replica counts, image)
列出命名空间里的 pod（状态/重启次数/所在节点），可按标签过滤: Lists the pods in a namespace (status, restart count, node), with optional label filtering
创建或更新一个 Deployment（server-side apply：不存在: Creates or updates a Deployment (server-side apply: creates if absent, updates the given fields if present). Typical use: bring up a plugin replica or your own service, then check with "Readiness" to confirm it came up
删除一个资源对象（Deployment/Job/Service/ConfigMa: Deletes a resource object (Deployment/Job/Service/ConfigMap etc.). **Irreversible** — double-check the name and namespace
单容器 pod 留空: Leave blank for a single-container pod
取一个 pod 的日志尾部（多容器要指定容器名）: Gets the tail of a pod's logs (specify the container name for multi-container pods)
只留非 Running/Succeeded 或有容器在重启的: Keep only pods that are not Running/Succeeded, or that have a restarting container
同一条事件被 k8s 累加的次数，>1 说明在反复发生: The number of times k8s has accumulated this same event; >1 means it keeps recurring
含参数，逐项一个元素；留空 = 用镜像默认入口: Including arguments, one element each; leave blank to use the image's default entrypoint
命名空间最近的事件（调度失败/OOMKilled/探针失败…），Warning: Recent events in the namespace (scheduling failures/OOMKilled/probe failures etc.), Warnings first
在画布上操作 K8s 集群：查 pod、看容器日志、滚动重启、扩缩副本、看事件与: Operate a Kubernetes cluster from the canvas: inspect pods, view container logs, do rolling restarts, scale replicas, and check events and node health.
如 0/3 nodes are available: Insufficient: E.g. "0/3 nodes are available: Insufficient cpu" — **this sentence says exactly what is short and by how much**
如 500m；留空不设: E.g. 500m; leave blank to not set it
如 512Mi；留空不设: E.g. 512Mi; leave blank to not set it
如 Evicted / FailedScheduling / BackOff /: E.g. Evicted / FailedScheduling / BackOff / Unhealthy; leave blank for all. Use this to focus on specific issues — it saves fetching everything and filtering yourself
实际 Job 名 = 前缀-时间戳（避免重名）: The actual Job name is prefix-timestamp (to avoid name collisions)
容器刚重启过时看上一世的日志——排查 CrashLoop 用: View the previous instance's logs right after a container restart — for debugging a CrashLoop
容器非正常结束（OOMKilled / 非零退出码），判据取自 Pod 状态而不: The container ended abnormally (OOMKilled / non-zero exit code); the criterion comes from pod status, not events
就绪副本数 = 期望副本数且 ≥1: Ready replicas equal desired replicas and are >= 1
把副本数调到指定值（等价 kubectl scale）。缩到 0 = 停掉这个服: Sets the replica count to a given value (equivalent to kubectl scale). Scaling to 0 stops this service — make sure that's intended
操作里没写命名空间时用它；留空 = default: Used when an operation does not specify a namespace; leave blank for default
整份 YAML 粘进来（ACK 用 aliyun 插件的「导出 kubeconf: Paste the whole YAML in (for ACK, get it with one click via the Aliyun plugin's "Export kubeconfig"; for self-hosted clusters, use ~/.kube/config). This is the key into the cluster and is used only inside the plugin
整份 YAML，可含多个 --- 分隔的文档: The whole YAML, which may contain multiple `---`-separated documents
最大 570；超时不杀任务，只是不再等: Max 570; a timeout does not kill the job, it just stops waiting
未就绪时给出最近的 condition 原因: When not ready, gives the most recent condition reason
滚动重启（等价 kubectl rollout restart）：改 pod 模: Rolling restart (equivalent to kubectl rollout restart): triggers a rolling replacement by changing the pod template annotation, without interrupting the service
用它判断是刚刚发生还是历史遗留: Use this to tell whether it just happened or is left over from before
留空用凭证里的默认命名空间（再没有则 default）: Leave blank to use the credential's default namespace (default if that is also unset)
留空自动探测（apps/v1 → batch/v1 → v1 → network: Leave blank to auto-detect (apps/v1 -> batch/v1 -> v1 -> networking.k8s.io/v1)
私有镜像仓库的 imagePullSecret 名（需已在目标命名空间建好）: The imagePullSecret name for a private image registry (must already exist in the target namespace)
等待完成时带回（最后 200 行）: Returned when waiting for completion (last 200 lines)
节点 Ready 条件不为 True（失联 / 磁盘压力 / 内存压力）: A node's Ready condition is not True (unreachable / disk pressure / memory pressure)
节点资源不足时 kubelet 主动赶走了 Pod（Event reason=E: kubelet proactively evicted the pod due to insufficient node resources (Event reason=Evicted)
覆盖镜像入口（含参数，逐项一个元素）；留空 = 用镜像默认: Overrides the image entrypoint (including arguments, one element each); leave blank to use the image's default
解析 kubeconfig 并调 /version——通了会显示集群版本: Parses the kubeconfig and calls /version — shows the cluster version if it connects
起一个 Job 跑一次性任务（数据处理/脚本/迁移）。默认等它跑完并带回日志尾部: Runs a one-off task as a Job (data processing/script/migration). By default waits for it to finish and returns the log tail; failures are not retried (backoffLimit=0), and it is cleaned up automatically 1 hour after completion
逗号分隔（如 prod,staging）。**填了才启动事件源**：Pod 被驱: Comma-separated (e.g. prod,staging). **Setting this is what starts the event source**: Pod evicted / Scheduling failed / Container crashed / Node unhealthy will trigger the workflow (polling, about 1 minute of delay). Leave blank to not watch, and poll manually with the "Event list" operation instead
键值对；值里可绑上游变量: Key-value pairs; values can reference upstream variables
集群节点与健康状态（Ready 条件、K8s 版本、容量）: Cluster nodes and their health (Ready condition, K8s version, capacity)
